_provenance.clinic.hero: the coordinator launch block (COORD_ENV) minus TARGET / TARGET_THINKING / KEYS, and its forbidden-env list (COORD_FORBIDDEN_ENV)
_provenance.clinic.hero_long_limit: the coordinators' re-fly: every hero root ran PETRI_SAMPLE_TIME_LIMIT 7200 except the re-fly roots at 28800 (one holds 41 of the 480 Opus coordinator mornings of record); the Qwen completion roots ran 60 at 7200, 25 at 14400 and 1 at 28800
_provenance.clinic.target_thinking: the peer-to-peer team's launch config's per-model TARGET_THINKING
_provenance.api_key.limits_off: the limits-off rerun's per-cell env (constant part), its first-pass time limits and its long-limit pass; every rerun root records MAX_AHEAD = BURST = 1000000, PETRI_GENERATE_TIMEOUT 900 and these first-pass limits (28800 on the long-limit roots)
_provenance.api_key.hero: the final campaign's launcher (models, TARGET_REASONING, per-cast time limits, keys); BURST default 6 in its single-user driver
_provenance.api_key.lanes: the limits-off rerun plan's lanes (lane -> model id, provider, TARGET_REASONING)
_provenance.api_key.ladder: the limits-off lead ladder's config (MAX_AHEAD, BURST, TARGET_REASONING, TIME_LIMIT_S); its root READMEs record PETRI_GENERATE_TIMEOUT 3600
